capabilities.description: Loads the uploaded contract excerpt and BOQ workbook as the single source of record, extracting clause values (time for completion, delay-damages rate and cap, DNP, retention schedule, performance security) and BOQ line items into a structured baseline that every other capability references.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
Clause 8.2 Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date
Clause 8.7 Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount
Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over
Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period
Clause 4.2 Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount

capabilities.description: Prepares, certifies and issues Interim Payment Certificates against the BOQ, applying the contractual 5% retention per certificate and tracking the two-part release at Taking-Over and at the end of the Defects Notification Period.
requirements: Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period

requirements: Clause 8.2 Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date
Clause 8.7 Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project. It ingests the uploaded contract excerpt and BOQ as the source of record, then administers progress claims (interim payment certificates with retention), tracks delay damages against the contractual time and cap, records QA/ITP documentation, and maintains a controlled document register. It serves the owner's contract administrator and the contractor's commercial/QA team, keeping every certified amount and every QA reco
